title: Star-Crossed Young Lovers
front_description: On her home planet of Naboo, Senator Amidala takes a brief respite from her tense political troubles and enjoys some quality time with Anakin. clear these two young people are smitten with each other. That night, at Padmé's lovely lake manor, they confess their deep feelings for each other and wonder what destiny has in store for their relationship.
back_description: Iain McCarg's design of Padmé in one of her most alluring costumes.
